journal_lines: Blue dust in the cracks. Lapis.
Deep blue vein. Rich and consistent.
Pigment in the stone. Took it carefully.
Lapis runs wide here. Good find.
Blue the color of the sky has never been. Sky-color from underneath.
Lapis in the wall like a piece of a forgotten evening.
Powder so blue it stained the paw. Did not mind.
The stone smelled like rain held back for centuries.
A nodule pressed into the deepslate like a thumbprint in clay.
Blue dust on the muzzle for hours after. Looked like winter.
Lapis takes the torchlight oddly. The torchlight goes home different.
Found the seam. Followed the seam. Brought the seam.
